environment.description: ECS Fargate task running on platform version 1.4.0 with default task definition. Container image built with gcc -O0 (no stack protector, no ASLR in container PID namespace). Task role has no restrictions. Container filesystem is read-write (default). awsvpc networking mode with security group allowing inbound TCP 8080. No seccomp profile applied (Docker default). tmpfs mounted at /tmp and /var/log/service for log writes.
